mandatory_manpaths.description: Mandatory manual page directories — always included in search paths, even if environment defines MANPATH.

manpaths.description: Additional manual page directories — included only if not overridden by environment MANPATH.

setenv_manpath.description: If true, set up MANPATH_MAP for default environmentless lookup of manual pages.

manpath_map.description: When setenv_manpath is true, maps command search paths to their corresponding man directories (format: <command path>:<man path>).

locale_manpaths.description: Locale-specific manual page mappings. Keys are locale names (e.g., 'en', 'de'); values are lists of man directories for that locale.

system_man_dirs.description: System manual page directories — explicitly listed for clarity or override. Often auto-detected, but listing them ensures consistency.
